name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 120 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 120 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israel intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting a UN rights office warning of an ethnic cleansing nightmare, while Israeli forces demolished homes of Palestinians blamed for a Hebron shooting. Israeli drones struck the southern Gaza Strip, wounding 14 people, and IDF strikes in Gaza killed a Hamas commander who had held hostages and four Hamas operatives in separate attacks. Shin Bet is allowing Hamas operatives to choose whether they are killed alone or with their families, and settlers attacked West Bank olive harvesters, wounding at least three. The UN Commission reported war crimes and genocide even after a Gaza ceasefire, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel intensiverte en nedslag i Hebron, der tusenvis ble fordrevet og FN-s rettighetskontor advarte om et etnisk rensningsmareritt, mens israelske styrker revet ned hjem til palestinere som ble anklaget for en skyting i Hebron. Israelske droner slo mot den sørlige Gazastripen og såret 14 personer, og IDF-angrep i Gaza drepte en Hamas-kommandør som hadde holdt gisler samt fire Hamas-operatører i separate angrep. Shin Bet lar Hamas-operatører velge om de skal bli drept alene eller sammen med sine familier, og bosettere angrep olivenplukkere på Vestbredden, der minst tre ble såret. FN-kommisjonen rapporterte krigsforbrytelser og folkemord selv etter en våpenhvile i Gaza, og 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
